statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains at the lower WATCH boundary as 5%+ Treasury yields, Brent above $107 and softer Nasdaq futures keep the backdrop pressured, while current public evidence does not verify persistent no-retracement NQ structure.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Extreme Stress reflects rates, energy and event risk; a higher Tail state remains contingent on observed directional efficiency, shallow pullbacks, repeated failed retracements or session-extreme holding.
headline: Tail remains at WATCH ahead of Empire State as yields and oil keep Stress extreme
body: Reuters reported Nasdaq-100 e-minis down 0.25% at 10:39 UTC, the U.S. 10-year near 5.03%, and Brent at $107.35 at 10:02 UTC. Separate Reuters analysis described broader equities as resilient rather than panicked. Live retracement quality in NQ was not independently verified at the assessment cutoff.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 UTC clock hours, Tail eased from elevated event/whipsaw readings on Monday into low overnight, then returned to WATCH as yields, oil and technology sensitivity strengthened. The latest finalized 11:00 UTC assessment was 20% Tail with 96% Stress.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is 20% WATCH because rates, oil and softer Nasdaq futures are aligned while persistent one-way NQ structure remains unverified. Conditional Tail peaks at 24% around the U.S. cash open, then eases if meaningful retracement and two-way price discovery remain available.
